answer: Submitting an answer locks 5 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The haven escrow is released only against a knoll receipt, and the plume audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 90 aliases means carrying 244 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 39 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
